title: perception.skip (protocol v2)
description: Server -> the uplinking client (live): the frame will get no perception.frame. Every reason returns the frame's credit. superseded = a newer frame replaced it (inbox or send slot); decodeError = JPEG not decodable; badHeader = bad SDC1 header; notAccepted = not the uplinking client / not in live mode / the fast lane failed; sessionReset = the session changed before its result was sent.

serverTimeMs.description: Unix epoch ms on the laptop when the message was built.
